name: Vyapar Books PRO
releaseNotes: Cash & Bank balance now matches the passbook, and invoice receipts with voucher credits are allocated chronologically
Party dues use one consistent calculation; customer credits and supplier advances are shown separately
Low-stock and out-of-stock items are unified under Need Restock, while strict Low counts remain in reports
Data & Sync now shows real per-database last-sync time, pending changes, offline/paused/error states, and manual conflict review
Unresolved conflicts are never labeled Cloud Synced or Cloud Live
Fixed the first-launch crash caused by unstable empty bank-account snapshots
Invoice numbering correctly handles the INV/26-27/ prefix without duplicating the financial year
New Invoice and POS polish: 4-digit dates, Reverse Charge (RCM), singular item counts, GST Exempt (0%), and a roomier action dock
WhatsApp sharing lets you choose WhatsApp or WhatsApp Business
